rationale: Multi-day high/low channel breakout with avg-TR volatility filter. Long/short on close above (below) the PRIOR N-bar channel plus width*channel-size buffer. Longer-horizon fills-with-direction per BP#43 §17.8; not counter-trend LIMIT. N+18c audit patch: channel window excludes the current bar (standard Donchian); original LLM emission included current bar which made both breakout legs unreachable.
n18c_patch_notes: max_high / min_low computed over self.highs[:-1] / self.lows[:-1] instead of full window; preserves LLM strategy concept, fixes off-by-one that made triggers unreachable.
